The signs display white text indicating street names ('CICERO' and 'WILLOWBROOK'). Snow is visible on the branches of trees in the lower left foreground and on top of the sign hardware. Power lines traverse the upper portion of the frame.

The left sign reads something like 'CICANO' instead of a standard name, and the right sign's text trails off into illegible characters. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of letters but fails semantic coherence.
The mounting hardware and the edge of the upper-right sign appear slightly warped and fused with the snow accumulation, lacking the crisp mechanical definition expected of metal brackets.
